items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And Wynonie, when he rehearsed, he’d say, “Okay, play me a shuffle in B flat.”

ctx.x: So you were in a house band and the singers would come through. And you’d just do your best to fit into their styles.

That was very easy for us because first of all we were very good musicians. Second of all, they would come in the night before they were supposed to open, and watch the other guy close. So we had a chance to talk to them you know, sit at the bar and hang out and talk. And so we’d connect with their attitude right away see. And in fact I was thinking about Jo Jones’ cousin was Wynonie Harris. That’s his first cousin. And Wynonie, when he rehearsed, he’d say, “Okay, play me a shuffle in B flat.” [brief scat].…
